title: MENAKE (Official Music Video) by Tanmay Gururaj ft. Anjali Anish
subtitle: Menake by Tanmay Gururaj ft. Anjali Anish | Official Music Video
headerDescription: Official music video for Menake, a Kannada indie-pop single by artist and composer Tanmay Gururaj, featuring Anjali Anish. Directed and shot by Pratham Raje Urs, with music video production by Talon Production House.

credits.name: Ridhi Harish, Saanvi Mohata, Mahima Dash, Vinayashree T Kulkarni, Kinjal Anchaliya, Nischitha Reddy, Nimisha Anand
Premalatha Gururaj, Anu, Rakesh Yadav, Akhil, Karthikeya Bramha, Sahana, Harish, Sandeep Kolar, Jananya T, Adhishree U Rao, Snigdha Belavadi, Rathan Gangadhar & Family, Mahendra Gowda & Family

synopsis:
Menake is a Kannada indie-pop music video by Tanmay Gururaj ft. Anjali Anish, directed by Pratham Raje Urs and produced by Talon Production House. The single is Tanmay Gururaj's fourth Kannada independent release, and Talon Production House handled the music video production from shoot to delivery.

The video tells a warm, romantic story through small everyday moments: an instant camera and a handmade scrapbook, quiet conversations in cafe and garden settings, and a candlelit birthday surprise, before opening into a dreamy, choreographed dance sequence in deep reds and gold. Pratham Raje Urs directed and handled cinematography, with Infant John A as associate cinematographer and Dhiya TS as assistant director. Vikram Adithya Reddy served as executive producer. Prashant Daniel graded the film, with DI and VFX by One Shot Post.

The dream sequence was choreographed by Sadhwin Shetty and Shashank, with art direction by Sankalp Ashirwad Mandol, background dancer outfits by INTARA, equipment from Swasthi Info Media and behind-the-scenes coverage by Ether Media. Menake follows Jhumki as Talon Production House's latest music video with Tanmay Gururaj, part of the studio's ongoing work in music video production for independent artists in Bengaluru.
studioNoteHeading: Partly Shot at Talon Production House
studioNote: Parts of Menake were filmed at Talon Production House's own studio space in J. P. Nagar, Bengaluru, with the rest shot on location. The studio portions used Talon's in-house shooting environment and crew.

title: JHUMKI (Official Music Video) by Tanmay Gururaj
subtitle: Jhumki by Tanmay Gururaj | Official Music Video
headerDescription: Official music video for Jhumki, a Kannada independent single by artist and composer Tanmay Gururaj. Talon Production House handled the music video production for Jhumki.
synopsis:
Jhumki is a Kannada indie-pop single by artist and composer Tanmay Gururaj. Talon Production House handled the music video production for the official Jhumki video, which was filmed at Talon's own studio space in Bengaluru.

Directed, filmed and edited by Pratham Raje Urs, the video stars Yuktha L and uses a colourful, high-energy visual style that reflects the playful character of the track. Vikram Adithya Reddy served as executive producer, with Infant John as assistant director. Rebel Frame Productions supported the production with lighting and equipment.

The Jhumki music video is part of Talon Production House's work in music video production and artist-led visual projects, bringing together in-house studio production, cinematography, lighting, post-production and creative direction for independent music releases.
studioNote: Jhumki was filmed at Talon Production House's own studio space in Bengaluru. The production used Talon's in-house shooting environment, with lighting and equipment support from Rebel Frame Productions.
